speaker: Elder Moisés Villanueva
title: “Prove Me Now Herewith”
session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Moisés Villanueva spoke about ““Prove Me Now Herewith””.

quotes.text: After a sacrament meeting, a faithful sister shared that her testimony of the law of tithing had begun to weaken. She explained that although she had always paid a full tithe, she had never received the job promotion she had hoped for nor even the salary increase she deserved.
quotes.speaker: Elder Moisés Villanueva
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: In his address “ The Windows of Heaven,” Elder David A. Bednar taught, “As we live the law of tithing, we often receive significant but subtle blessings that are not always what we expect and easily can be overlooked” (Liahona, Nov. 2013, 17).
quotes.speaker: Elder Moisés Villanueva
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: These blessings, both temporal and spiritual—and many others—are evidence that the Lord has indeed opened the windows of heaven and poured out His promised blessings in abundance. I invited that sister to write her own list of the significant yet subtle blessings the Lord had given her—blessings that are often easy to overlook.
quotes.speaker: Elder Moisés Villanueva
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I was reminded of the Lord’s words to the children of Israel: “And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot” (Deuteronomy 29:5).
quotes.speaker: Elder Moisés Villanueva
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Elijah found the widow gathering sticks. He asked her for some water and for a morsel of bread. She explained that she had only a handful of meal and a little oil—enough to prepare one final meal for herself and her son and then die.
quotes.speaker: Elder Moisés Villanueva
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Elijah then said, “Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son” (1 Kings 17:13).
quotes.speaker: Elder Moisés Villanueva
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Then the Lord’s promise was fulfilled: “And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by Elijah” (1 Kings 17:16).
quotes.speaker: Elder Moisés Villanueva
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: When we live the law of tithing, the Lord indeed opens the windows of heaven and pours out His promised blessings “that there shall not be room enough to receive it” (Malachi 3:10). I so testify in the sacred name of Jesus Christ, amen.
quotes.speaker: Elder Moisés Villanueva
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

scriptures.text: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.

There is a law, irrevocably decreed in heaven before the foundations of this world, upon which all blessings are predicated-- And when we obtain any blessing from God, it is by obedience to that law upon which it is predicated.
Who am I, saith the Lord, that have promised and have not fulfilled?
And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.
And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.
And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.

And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much. And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing. And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
